content.short: DEGA provides scalable infrastructure and fast transactions for Web3 gaming and the Metaverse.
content.description:

Additionally, you need to prioritize the building blocks of Web3 infrastructure and asset management to create truly successful games. However, only 4% of developer have taken initiative to learn.
